title: Sender UX state machine
description: Track per-message delivery state on the sender side: (1) Sending - POST not yet ACKed by any custodian, (2) Sent - 2.01 from first custodian, (3) Delivered - explicit receipt or ack_through received, (4) Expired - TTL expired with no receipt. No retry after expiry; user decides whether to resend. Expose state to UI/client API. Spec: 12-apps.md §18.1.2 sender UX states table. All three impls. Depends on: ack_through (ldhl.10), explicit receipt (ldhl.11).
